contexts.text: To comfort us concerning our work (). Explained.
It was granted to comfort them.
The Lord's consolation after the combats of temptations. Signified. AC 1787. AC 1801. AC 1865.
The salvation of the human race was the Lord's only comfort...
Comfort. Signified.
The influx of the Lord into the affection of truth, when it is in the deepest grief on account of deprivation, is comfort.
Afterwards, it treats of comfort, re-creation, and instruction after desolation. AC 2708:3.
Comfort from the Divine itself. Signified.
A perception of comfort in the Divine good of the Rational after temptation. Signified.
Truth, from which comes combat; good, from which comes comfort.
Consolation of the Lord still greater. Signified.
To cry out of Heaven = to console.
No one has any consolation except from those things which are of his love.
Isaac was comforted after his mother's death () = a new state; for to receive comfort = a new state, because the state of comfort is new...

Esau thy brother is comforting himself for thee, to kill thee () = a disposition to invert the state, and to deprive truth of life from itself. To comfort one's self for anyone = to appease unrest of mind with hope. AC 4783.
To comfort () = interpretations which are made from the sense of the letter. Explained.
To give grace in temptations, is to comfort and uplift with hope.
Wherefore, when this truth comes into the light, he who is in temptations receives comfort, and is uplifted with hope.
Who does not comfort a sick person, by saying...
Comfort after hard things. Signified.
Shaddai = temptation, and comfort after temptation; here, therefore, comfort after the hard things which had been suffered in Egypt.
Joseph comforted them () = hope. To comfort = to calm the unrest of the mind with hope.
To comfort is predicated of the understanding.
Falsities take away the light, and thus the perception of consolation by truths from him who is in temptation; but when the man emerges from temptation...
The Lord's temptations as to the human, and the temptations of the faithful, and afterwards consolations. Signified.
(After deliverance from a state of despair in temptations) man for the most part is brought into a bright state of hope, and thence into consolation.
The encampment at Elim = consolation after temptation. AC 8367, Explained.
Consolation after temptations is signified and described by the manna which they received, and by the quails.
Consolation by the Lord. Signified.
There is no comfort for such...
After temptations there is consolation. References.
Weep not = consolation.
The contrition which is said... to be followed by the consolation of the Gospel, is not repentance. General article.
Wherefore it is said, to comfort all that mourn (). AE 612:6.
Jehovah shall comfort Zion (). Explained.
The breast of her consolations () = the Divine good.
That this is for the sake of reformation and regeneration, is signified by, Jehovah hath comforted His people ().
I am He that comforteth you (). Explained.
That there no longer remained any spiritual truth, is signified by, Rachel weeping for her sons, refuseth to receive comfort upon her sons, because there is not any ().
To comfort () = to restore the Church.
Thy rod and Thy staff shall comfort me () = that Divine spiritual truth together with Divine natural truth will give protection, because they possess power... To comfort = to protect.
That Church is meant by Zion, and its establishment and their reformation by to comfort ().

That there is not any nourishment of faith and of the understanding, because there are no longer any truths in consequence of evils of life, is signified by, Far from me is he that comforteth, who restoreth my soul ().
Consolation by the Lord after temptations. Signified.

Something shall now be said about consolations after temptations... When the evils and falsities of man have been removed, the temptations are over, and when they are over there flows in joy through Heaven from the Lord, and fills his natural mind; it is this joy which is here meant by consolations. All who undergo spiritual temptations receive these consolations. I speak from experience.
Comfort ye My people (). Explained.
